evidence.notes: Classic stored text and HTML templates merge who and what fields and expand local Attachment plus ContentDocument/ContentVersion files for NONE, METADATA_ONLY, and METADATA_WITH_BODY.
The local runtime accepts the five-argument overload while usage mutation remains a hosted-service row unless a local usage field is represented.

name: core-runtime-messaging-render-template-full-local
salesforceExclusionReason: Salesforce requires a real Email folder and org-owned template context for this attachment-rendering fixture; the synthetic FolderId is rejected in the scratch org. Retain the deterministic local renderer proof and defer hosted runtime.

source.content:
@isTest private class CoreRuntimeMessagingRenderTemplateFullLocalTest { @isTest static void rows() { Account account = new Account(Name = 'TrailWorks'); insert account; Contact contact = new Contact(FirstName = 'Ada', LastName = 'Trail', AccountId = account.Id); insert contact; EmailTemplate template = new EmailTemplate(Name = 'Full Local', DeveloperName = 'Full_Local', FolderId = '00l000000000001AAA', Subject = 'Hello {!Recipient.FirstName} at {!RelatedTo.Name}', HtmlValue = '

{!Contact.Name} / {!Account.Name}

', Body = '{!Contact.Name} / {!Account.Name}'); System.runAs(new User(Id = UserInfo.getUserId())) { insert template; } Attachment contract = new Attachment(ParentId = template.Id, Name = 'contract.txt', ContentType = 'text/plain', Body = Blob.valueOf('contract body')); insert contract; Attachment brief = new Attachment(ParentId = template.Id, Name = 'brief.pdf', ContentType = 'application/pdf', Body = Blob.valueOf('brief body')); insert brief; Messaging.SingleEmailMessage withBody = Messaging.renderStoredEmailTemplate((Id)template.Id, (Id)contact.Id, (Id)account.Id, Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption.METADATA_WITH_BODY); System.assertEquals('Hello Ada at TrailWorks', withBody.getSubject()); System.assertEquals('

Ada Trail / TrailWorks

', withBody.getHtmlBody()); System.assertEquals('Ada Trail / TrailWorks', withBody.getPlainTextBody()); System.assertEquals(2, withBody.getFileAttachments().size()); System.assertEquals('contract.txt', withBody.getFileAttachments()[0].getFileName()); System.assertEquals('contract body', withBody.getFileAttachments()[0].getBody().toString()); Messaging.SingleEmailMessage metadataOnly = Messaging.renderStoredEmailTemplate((Id)template.Id, (Id)contact.Id, (Id)account.Id, Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption.METADATA_ONLY); System.assertEquals(2, metadataOnly.getFileAttachments().size()); System.assertEquals(null, metadataOnly.getFileAttachments()[0].getBody()); Messaging.SingleEmailMessage none = Messaging.renderStoredEmailTemplate((Id)template.Id, (Id)contact.Id, (Id)account.Id, Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption.NONE); System.assertEquals(0, none.getFileAttachments().size()); } }
